title: Emit guided onboarding telemetry events (Console web + backend) with dedupe + idempotency
creator: Dylan Brooks
related_links: Confluence: Onboarding Telemetry Event Schema v1 (2026-01-24, updated 2026-02-21)
Linear: PM-484 Onboarding funnel metrics and dashboards
GitHub: redwood/pr-48255 (Instrument onboarding telemetry events; allowlist + dedupe keys)
body:
## Context
We’re shipping the Console guided onboarding checklist (Hosted API / self-serve). To measure TTFS + step funnel drop-off and to support validator health monitoring, we need consistent telemetry emitted from:
- **Console Web** (UI interactions + navigation + docs attribution)
- **Console Backend** (step completions + validator signals)

This ticket implements the producers and enforces:
- strict schema + property allowlist
- stable identity fields (org/project/user/anonymous/session)
- **dedupe_key** generation (client + server)
- idempotent behavior under retries (client network retries, backend retries, worker replays)
- privacy constraints (no customer prompt/content, no raw URLs/queries beyond UTM allowlist)

## Requirements (must match schema v1)
Reference: **Onboarding Telemetry Event Schema v1**.

### Event names to emit (v1)
**Console Web (sampled at 25% unless overridden by allowlisted org config):**
- onboarding.checklist_viewed
- onboarding.step_viewed
- onboarding.step_started
- onboarding.docs_link_clicked
- onboarding.console_deeplink_opened

**Console Backend (100%):**
- onboarding.step_completed
- onboarding.validation_signal_received
- onboarding.checklist_completed

### Common envelope rules
All events must include:
- event_name, event_version=1.0, emitted_at (RFC3339)
- source: console_web | console_backend
- environment: prod | staging
- schema_context=guided_onboarding_checklist
- session_id (required; backend should forward from request context when possible)
- dedupe_key (required)

Identity:
- Authenticated Console contexts must include org_id; include user_id when logged in.
- Console web must include anonymous_id when user_id is not available.
- project_id is required for project-scoped step events (most steps in Phase 1).

### Privacy constraints (hard blockers)
Must NOT emit:
- prompt text, completions, embeddings, tool args/results
- API keys, auth headers, full request/response payloads
- freeform error messages/stack traces
- full referrer URLs

Docs URLs:
- Emit **doc_url_path** only; strip host.
- Strip query params except: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content.

### Dedupe + idempotency (critical)
We expect duplicate attempts due to retries and eventual consistency. Ensure we can safely replay.

**Console Web**
- Generate dedupe_key per schema guidance (session-scoped for view/click events).
- Use stable session_id generation (same as existing Console telemetry session concept).

**Console Backend**
- For step_completed: ensure it is emitted **only once per (org_id, project_id, step_id)** for a given checklist_version.
- For validation_signal_received: include a dedupe_key based on (org_id, project_id, validator_name, signal_timestamp) so reprocessing doesn’t explode volume.

Additionally, backend should not double-emit step_completed when:
- API retries occur
- PATCH requests are retried with the same idempotency key
- validator worker replays a message

## Implementation plan
### 1) Console Web producer (telemetry SDK wrapper)
- Add an `OnboardingTelemetry` module with:
  - compile-time property allowlist (TS types + runtime filter)
  - standard envelope builder (reads org_id/project_id/user_id/anonymous_id/session_id)
  - sampling gate (stable hash on org_id || anonymous_id)
  - dedupe_key helpers per event type
- Hook emission points:
  - checklist render -> onboarding.checklist_viewed (once per session)
  - step row expanded/clicked -> onboarding.step_viewed (once per step per session, include ui_action)
  - step CTA clicked -> onboarding.step_started
  - docs link clicks from checklist -> onboarding.docs_link_clicked (strip URL)
  - internal Console navigation from checklist -> onboarding.console_deeplink_opened (route_name)

### 2) Console Backend producer
- Add `onboarding_telemetry.emit(event)` utility with:
  - server-side allowlist enforcement (drop unknown props)
  - required field validation (fail closed in staging, fail open with counters in prod)
  - explicit source=console_backend
- Emission points:
  - When checklist state transitions to complete -> onboarding.step_completed
  - In validators (first request / streaming / api key created, etc.) -> onboarding.validation_signal_received
  - When all required steps completed -> onboarding.checklist_completed

### 3) Dedupe enforcement + idempotent state transitions
- Step completion emission must be tied to the **authoritative state update** (server-side): emit only when DB update actually transitions from incomplete -> complete.
- Use an atomic update pattern (e.g., UPDATE ... WHERE status != complete; check affected rows == 1) so retries don’t re-emit.
- Include request_id when available.

### 4) Metrics + guardrails
- Counters:
  - onboarding_telemetry_emitted_total{event_name, source, env}
  - onboarding_telemetry_dropped_total{reason}
  - onboarding_telemetry_validation_failed_total{field}
- Add logs only in staging; prod logs must not contain event payloads.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] All v1 events listed above are emitted in the right places with required properties.
- [x] Events contain only allowlisted properties; prohibited data is never emitted.
- [x] dedupe_key generation matches schema guidance and is stable.
- [x] Retries/replays do not cause duplicate step_completed emissions (server transition check).
- [x] URL stripping verified for docs_link_clicked.
- [x] Sampling applied to UI events with stable hashing; backend events at 100%.
- [x] Verified in staging with at least one end-to-end flow (new org -> create key -> first request -> see step completion).

## QA / Test plan
- Unit tests:
  - dedupe_key helpers (deterministic)
  - URL scrubber (drops host, drops query except UTM allowlist)
  - allowlist filter (drops unknown props)
- Integration tests (staging):
  - repeated PATCH with same idempotency key doesn’t double-emit
  - validator replay doesn’t double-emit step_completed
  - UI sampling stable for same org across sessions

## Rollout notes
- Behind existing guided onboarding feature flag cohorting.
- Staging first; then beta allowlist. If telemetry volume surprises, reduce sampling rate for UI events (keep backend at 100%).

## Notes / Open questions
- Backend should forward session_id from Console request headers when present; if missing, emit without session_id is NOT allowed per schema. Current approach: require Console to send session_id header for relevant backend calls and validators that execute in that request context.
- For async validator paths without an active Console session: emit with a generated session_id? Schema says session_id required; confirm with Telemetry Platform if we can use a stable synthetic session_id (e.g., "backend") for console_backend events. (Resolved below in comments.)
comments: 2026-02-03 (Dylan Brooks): Prioritize this; without these events PM/Analytics can’t build the funnel and we can’t measure TTFS improvements. Align strictly to Nadia’s schema doc; no ad-hoc fields.

2026-02-04 (Nadia Rahman): Drafted producer checklist. Key point: all numeric/boolean values must be string-encoded per v1 ("true"/"false", integers as strings). Please don’t send raw booleans from the web client—warehouse typing drift has bitten us before.

2026-02-05 (Logan Wright): For backend-only events (validator worker) that don’t have a real Console session_id, OK to set session_id="backend" (literal string) for console_backend source *only*. Add a validation rule: console_web must always have UUID session_id; console_backend may have "backend". Document this in code comments and keep out of the public schema page for now; we can formalize in v1.1 if needed.

2026-02-06 (Marcus Lin): Privacy reminder: do not include exception messages or error stack traces in validation_signal_received. Use the enumerated error_code taxonomy only. For doc_url_path, ensure we strip *all* query params other than the UTM allowlist and do not send full URLs.

2026-02-10 (Hannah Rivera): Implemented Console Web hooks for checklist_viewed/step_viewed/step_started/docs_link_clicked/console_deeplink_opened. Added URL scrubber + allowlist filter. Sampling gate uses stable hash on org_id if present else anonymous_id. PR up shortly.

2026-02-12 (Nadia Rahman): Backend emission added for step_completed + validation_signal_received. Tied step_completed emit to DB transition (affected_rows == 1) to guarantee idempotency. Added metrics for dropped/invalid events. Please review the dedupe_key format for validation_signal_received; using org:project:validator:signal_timestamp.

2026-02-13 (Chloe Martin): Reviewed backend approach—looks good. Request: ensure request_id is populated for step_completed where we have it (state update called from HTTP path). For validator worker, no request_id available; that’s fine.
2026-02-14 (Mei Lin): Confirmed event_version stays at "1.0" and schema_context constant set. Once in staging, please post sample payloads (sanitized) to #analytics to validate parsing.

2026-02-15 (Nadia Rahman): Merged into redwood/pr-48255. Staging verification: saw checklist_viewed and docs_link_clicked in telemetry stream; step_completed fired exactly once after repeated PATCH retries. Posting follow-up to ENG-23119 for dashboards once data lands consistently.

2026-02-22 (Dylan Brooks): Marking Done. Next: ENG-23125 alerts + ENG-23119 dashboards. Keep an eye on missing events from one region during beta (see INT-3321) — may be unrelated but telemetry health dashboards should catch it quickly.
